$comment: First-class Award entity. Derived only from source-confirmed AWARDED tenders; an award is never inferred from a vendor list, a project, or a technical capability. Confidence limited/independently-sourced; values shown only where the source states them.

awards.title: China XD wins CNY 4.13bn in SGCC third-batch UHV & transmission equipment tenders
awards.award_basis: 中国西电7月22日公告：下属14家子公司中标国家电网2026年特高压项目第三次设备招标及输变电项目第三次变电设备招标，合计约41.29亿元 — UHV packages ~CNY 2.63bn (transformers, converter valves, capacitors, breakers, disconnectors) + T&D packages ~CNY 1.50bn (transformers, reactors, GIS, instrument transformers, arresters). China's third-batch UHV procurement wave is now converting into awards — domestic order books extend further into 2027.

awards.title: SGCC 8th-batch UHV equipment tender: CNY 1.7bn of reactors split among 7 firms
awards.source: Sina Finance 新浪财经 · 2 Jul 2026 [zh]
awards.award_basis: 国网第八批特高压设备招标：电抗器约17亿元由7家企业分食 — 中国能建39.4%居首、经纬正能38.2%、特变电工18%、思源2.8%。China's UHV second-batch 2026 procurement (>CNY 20bn total) keeps rolling into individual equipment awards — domestic UHV order books stay full into 2027.

awards.title: 中国西电 China XD Electric: 6 subsidiaries win CNY 1.899bn of State Grid UHV project procurement
awards.awardee: 中国西电 China XD Electric
awards.buyer: 中国西电 China XD Electric
awards.source: Dahe Cube 大河财立方 · 12 Jun 2026 [zh]
awards.award_basis: China XD Electric said six of its subsidiaries won State Grid procurement worth CNY 1.899bn for UHV (特高压) projects. The award extends the company's streak of large grid-equipment orders, consistent with accelerating State Grid UHV and AC/DC transmission construction.

awards.title: 平高电气 Pinggao Electric: wins CNY 876m of State Grid procurement
awards.award_basis: Pinggao Electric (平高电气) announced it won State Grid procurement tenders worth about CNY 876m. The listed switchgear maker's award reflects sustained State Grid spending on HV switchgear and related substation equipment. The 界面新闻 report quotes the announcement: the buyer is 国家电网有限公司 (State Grid Corporation of China).

awards.title: 中国西电 China XD Electric: 14 subsidiaries win CNY 1.447bn of State Grid procurement
awards.awardee: 中国西电 China XD Electric
awards.buyer: 中国西电 China XD Electric
awards.source: Sina Finance 新浪财经 · 30 Dec 2025 [zh]
awards.award_basis: China XD Electric (中国西电) announced that 14 of its subsidiaries jointly won State Grid (国家电网) procurement tenders totaling CNY 1.447bn. The award covers power-grid equipment including transformers and switchgear, underscoring continued State Grid purchasing of high-voltage apparatus from domestic manufacturers.

The notice fields retrieved do not state the contract value or name the substation. Original notice in Spanish. Buyer country on the notice: Spain (Alcobendas).
